subject: reasoning
question:
What is the letter at (2,3)?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdd99c70a842ff4ece5be0c515ab12d8b3c9024e129edb2ac26aaa903a43b508.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdd99c70a842ff4ece5be0c515ab12d8b3c9024e129edb2ac26aaa903a43b508.png] 

(2, 1), (2, 2), (2, 3), (2, 4) → H, I, J, K

(2, 1), (2, 2), (2, 3) → H, I, J

(1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3), (2, 3), (1, 4) → A, I, O, J, D

(2, 3) → L

So, (2, 3) represents the letter **L**.

Hence, **'Option 1’ **is the correct answer.
